$comment: Project profile for the canon-shipped harness (tools/harness in the sza plugin). Every omitted key keeps the canon default in tools/harness/_profile.ps1: PLAN/ and temp/ roots, the Sxxxx ticket grammar, the thirteen statuses, the release-plan file names. Only what differs from the defaults is written here. Run harness scripts through tools/harness.ps1, never by copying them.
$comment_modules: The stack is decided (owner, 2026-10-16, S0003): static HTML, CSS and ES modules, no build step, the served files are the source. The one build unit is the source root `web/` itself, so the module is named after it.
$comment_probes: Probe form of the static stack (S0003): a console.debug line carrying the ticket id, the browser counterpart of Timber.d. scanRoots/sourceRoots are the source tree `web/`; `tests/` pages carry no probes. The canon's probe gates read the file types from `sourceExtensions` below (blockneedusertest-probes.ps1, Get-ProbeSourceFile), so a JS probe is visible to them.

commands.$comment_statusCommands: S0041: the release plan's next command per status. Every working status runs the canon pipeline through the plugin forwarder /spec-all (the per-stage /spec-tech, /spec-dev, /spec-fix, /spec-check of the canon default do not exist here); BlockQuestions is drained by /spec-quiz. BlockNeedUserTest, BlockExternal and the ready statuses wait on a person and name no command. The small tiers /quick and /skill-fix are never a queue ticket's command.
commands.$comment_aliases: S0041: short names for this repository's own commands, rendered by the harness aliases/generate-command-aliases.ps1 into .claude/commands/<alias>.md. The spec commands' short forms (/sa, /sd, /sn, /sq) belong to the plugin's register-spec-commands.ps1 and are deliberately absent here, so the two generators never write one file. Latin set only; /quick is already short.
